caption: The drawing depicts an oval-shaped object, primarily rendered in shades of brown, black, and gold. The central section is an oval mesh or grid with a beige or light tan background, on which the red, stylized letters "P Y B" are displayed. Encircling this mesh is a frame, constructed of two interlocking bands—one in brown and another in black—with gold-colored bolts or rivets at intervals. Attached to either side of the oval frame are two symmetrical, outward-curving arms, each ending in a black and gold candle holder with a flared top that is brown. Above the oval frame are two small gold loops, one on each side of the top, likely intended for hanging. In the bottom left corner of the overall page is a small inset drawing of the same object, including a labeled dimension of 17 inches in width. The composition is centered on a plain, light, cream-colored background, with a thin rectangular border framing the main drawing. The artist's name, "Vincent P. Rozel," and a date are inscribed at the bottom right out of the main border.
title: Wall Hat Rack
